# 🔑 ChurchCRM 7.8.3: The "Open Doors" Release

**Release Date**: November 5, 2026
**Theme**: Member sign-in by email and passkey, giving statements that are easier to run, every PDF report on one engine, safer upgrades

Your members can now sign in to the Member Portal with their own email address, and your finance team has one clear place to start year-end giving statements. Reports, labels and name tags now share one PDF engine that follows your church's letterhead and language.

---

## ⚠️ Before You Upgrade

* **Member Portal sign-in changes on upgrade day.** Members sign in at `/portal/login` with a code or link emailed to them. The existing self-service logins stop working, and members no longer appear under **Admin → Users**, which now lists staff only. Email must be working on your server. Review **Admin → Member Portal** before you upgrade.
* **Staff sign in at `/admin`.** The old `/session/begin` address still works.
* **Members who share an email address** cannot be given portal sign-in until each person has their own address. The error names the people who share it.
* **The stock letterhead image is retired.** If your church never chose a letterhead, PDFs print your church name and address block. To use a logo, upload one under **Reports → Admin → Report Settings**. A letterhead path you typed yourself keeps working.
* **PHP 8.4 or newer** is required. If you host ChurchCRM on your own server, keep PHP patched.

---

## ✨ Exciting New Features

### 🔑 Members Sign In With Their Own Email
Members no longer need a username or a password.
* **Email code or link:** A member enters their email and ChurchCRM sends a code and a link. Links last 2 hours, and sessions end after 30 idle minutes.
* **Passkeys and remembered devices:** After the first sign-in, a member can add a passkey or stay signed in on their own device. Nothing is remembered unless they ask.
* **Sign-in and devices page:** Members see and remove their own devices.
* **Control for staff:** Turn sign-in on or off for any person, see who can sign in and when they last did, and view the audit trail (**Admin → Member Portal**).
* **Login as Person:** An administrator can view a member's portal from **People → [Name] → Actions**. It is read-only by default and every action is on the record. Staff accounts cannot be opened this way.
* **Email belongs to people:** The family email moves to the head of household or spouse, and the printed directory shows each person's own email.
* **Your language:** Members see the portal in the language they chose.

### 💰 Year-End Giving and Giving Statements
Your treasurer gets a starting point for the year's statements.
* **Year-End Giving page (Finance → Year-End Giving):** Pick a year, review families, payments and totals, work through a checklist (open deposits, payments not on a deposit, gifts with no family, church info), then preview, print or download.
* **Giving Statements page:** Choose the filters, preview the families and total in a popup, then download the PDF or CSV. Large churches can add every family without hitting a limit.
* **My Giving in the portal:** The head of household and spouse download their household's statement, with check numbers and the non-deductible amount shown.
* **Statement Settings (Finance → Admin):** Statement wording, signer, church tax ID and PDF handling in one auto-saving page. Finance users can use it without full administrator rights.

### 🖨️ One Letterhead, Uploaded in One Place
**Reports → Admin → Report Settings** lets you upload, preview and remove your church letterhead, and set the shared letter greeting and signature. Every PDF letter and statement uses it, and every family's statement in a combined PDF now starts with the letterhead.

### 📅 Repeat on the Nth Weekday
Recurring events can repeat on the "2nd Tuesday", in the Repeat Events editor and in a ministry's **New recurring event** dialog. Months without a 5th such weekday get no ev

detail.readme:
# ChurchCRM

ChurchCRM helps churches organize people and families, groups, events, attendance, giving, volunteers, and reports in one place.

**Free. No subscription. Your data is yours.**

ChurchCRM is open-source and self-hosted, so a church can choose where its information runs and how it is managed.

[![Software License](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-brightgreen.svg)](LICENSE)
[![GitHub All Releases](https://img.shields.io/github/downloads/ChurchCRM/CRM/total?color=blue&logo=github)](https://github.com/ChurchCRM/CRM/releases)
[![Latest Release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/churchcrm/crm?label=Latest%20Release)](https://github.com/ChurchCRM/CRM/releases/latest)
[![Latest Release Downloads](https://img.shields.io/github/downloads/ChurchCRM/CRM/latest/total?label=latest%20downloads&color=green)](https://github.com/ChurchCRM/CRM/releases/latest)

## Try it or install it

See the real product before you decide:

- **[Try the live demo](https://churchcrm.io/demo.html?utm_source=github&utm_medium=referral&utm_campaign=github_content&utm_content=crm_readme_demo)** — Softaculous creates a private, temporary ChurchCRM instance for you. It expires automatically; use fictional data only.
- **[Install ChurchCRM](https://churchcrm.io/install.html?utm_source=github&utm_medium=referral&utm_campaign=github_content&utm_content=crm_readme_install)** — run it on your own hosting with the official installation guidance.
- **[Run it with Docker](https://docs.churchcrm.io/installation/docker)** — official `churchcrm/crm` images on Docker Hub, built for amd64 and arm64 from each stable release.
- **[Read the documentation](https://docs.churchcrm.io/?utm_source=github&utm_medium=referral&utm_campaign=github_content&utm_content=crm_readme_docs)** — installation, configuration, administration, and user guides.

## What churches use it for

ChurchCRM supports real church workflows, including:

**People & families → Groups → Events & attendance → Giving & financial tracking → Volunteers → Reports**

## 🚀 Development quick start

If you're new to ChurchCRM, start with our **[Documentation](https://docs.churchcrm.io/?utm_source=github&utm_medium=referral&utm_campaign=github_content&utm_content=crm_readme_docs_start)**.
You'll find step-by-step installation instructions, configuration notes, and user guides there.

Quick start: see the "Quick Start" section in the Documentation for a fast setup.

For core development setup, architecture, builds, and testing, see [DEVELOPING.md](DEVELOPING.md).

## 🌐 Localization Support

ChurchCRM currently lists **49 supported locales**. Translation coverage varies by locale; see the generated audit report for the current status.

Join our [localization team on poeditor.com](https://poeditor.com/join/project/RABdnDSqAt) to contribute to your language’s support.

See the latest translation status and audit report: [locale/poeditor-audit.md](locale/poeditor-audit.md).

## 💡 Contributing

We welcome contributions from everyone! Whether it's bug reports, feature requests, or code contributions, your input is invaluable.

[See the contribution guidelines](CONTRIBUTING.md) for how to file issues and submit pull requests.

- Quick contributions: fork the repository, create a feature branch, run the test suite, and open a pull request; see CONTRIBUTING.md for details.

[![GitHub contributors](https://img.shields.io/github/contributors/churchcrm/crm.svg)](https://github.com/ChurchCRM/CRM/graphs/contributors)
[![Join the chat at Discord](https://img.shields.io/badge/Discord-ChurchCRM-5865F2?logo=discord&logoColor=white)](https://discord.gg/tuWyFzj3Nj)

## 📚 Documentation

Our [Documentation](https://docs.churchcrm.io/?utm_source=github&utm_medium=referral&utm_campaign=github_content&utm_content=crm_readme_docs_resource) is your go-to resource for understanding ChurchCRM.
If you notice anything missing or unclear, feel free to open an issue or submit a pull request.

## 🤝 Community

Join our [Discord community](https://discord.gg/tuWyFzj3Nj) to connect with other users, ask questions, and share your experiences.
We believe in the power of a supportive community!

## 🙏 Thank You

A heartfelt thank you to all our contributors, past and present. Your efforts make ChurchCRM better with every release.

### Recent Contribution History
